bigGame.text: No hunting game (except migratory birds) from 1 hour after sunset to 1 hour before sunrise. Synopsis page 11, item 38 (2 October 2026 edition).

migratory.text: Ducks and geese: half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset (south of 60 degrees north). Migratory Birds Regulations, 2022, s.28.

items.label: Hunter number
items.value: Now called FWID (Fish and Wildlife ID), 9 digits. Old hunter number plus 3 digits at the front. No physical card.
items.source: BC Fish and Wildlife ID page (search extract)

items.label: What to carry
items.value: Photo ID. Know your FWID number. All paper species licences for the year (used and unused). Federal bird permit (paper or phone) for ducks and geese.
items.source: BC hunting FAQ; ECCC permit page (search extracts)

items.label: Resident hunting licence
items.value: $32 (includes surcharge, not GST). Expires 31 March each year.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Licence year
items.value: 1 April to 31 March
items.source: Hunting Licensing Regulation, s.1 (search extract)

items.label: Mule deer species licence
items.value: $15 deer species licence (mule deer)
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: White tailed deer species licence
items.value: $15 deer species licence (white tailed deer)
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Buying species licences
items.value: Cannot be printed at home. Online orders are mailed (about 14 days). Hunting soon: buy in person.
items.source: BC species licences page (search extract)

items.label: Waiting period after buying
items.value: No wait for deer, moose, elk or black bear. A 2 day wait applies only to bobcat, caribou, cougar, lynx, mountain goat, mountain sheep and wolverine.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Quail and grouse licence (residents)
items.value: No species licence for residents. BC hunting licence only.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Federal Migratory Game Bird Hunting Permit
items.value: $17 + tax, stamp included. 2026 e permit valid 1 Aug 2026 to 30 Jun 2027. Buy online, carry on phone or paper.
items.source: ECCC permit page (search extract)

items.label: Shooting near buildings
items.value: No hunting or shooting within 100 m of a church, school, playground, regional park, or a dwelling house or farm or ranch building occupied by people or domestic animals. The owner exemption covers slaughtering livestock only, not hunting.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Unlicensed companion
items.value: May come along and watch, and help pack meat out, if not carrying a firearm or weapon and not hunting. Licensed hunter must stay with the meat unless a transport record is filled in.
items.source: BC hunting FAQ; Wildlife Act s.1 (search extracts)

items.label: Region 3 deer bag limit
items.value: Deer: 3 total. Mule deer 1. White tailed deer 2, either sex. Antlerless mule deer: LEH only. Your 1 mule deer buck counts across Regions 3 to 8 combined.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: MU (Management Unit) for Heffley Creek and Sun Peaks
items.value: Sun Peaks, Heffley Lake and Paul Lake: MU 3-27. Heffley Creek, highway side of the North Thompson: MU 3-27 (85%). West bank: MU 3-28.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly), Region 3 map

items.label: Region 3 mule deer season (your MU)
items.value: MU 3-27 and 3-28: 4 point bucks 10 to 30 Sept. ANY buck 1 to 31 Oct. 4 point bucks 1 Nov to 10 Dec. Antlerless: LEH only.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Region 8 quail (the synopsis row says only QUAIL)
items.value: quail (the synopsis row says only QUAIL), Region 8 MUs 8-1 to 8-15 and 8-21 to 8-26: 1 Oct to 30 Nov. Daily 10, possession 30.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Region 3 quail (the synopsis row says only QUAIL)
items.value: No quail season in Region 3 (no row in the season table).
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: BC Firearm Violence Prevention Act
items.value: In force 1 October 2026 (Order in Council 156/2026). Section 4: no loaded firearm in or on a boat. Section 5: no shooting in, on or from a boat. The Act also covers vehicles (news release, 85%). Hunting exemptions exist for boats only: a boat with no motor, or a motor that is not pushing the boat, while hunting or retrieving game.
items.note: Exemptions: Designation and Exemption Regulation s.18 and s.19, added by B.C. Reg. 66/2026. The Act text on BC Laws still showed [Not in force] on 2026-10-02 because that page lags. Vehicle rules: synopsis page 11 items 22 and 28 (2 October 2026 edition) and the federal transport rules.
items.source: OIC 156/2026 and B.C. Reg. 66/2026 on BC Laws, read directly

items.label: Report poaching (RAPP)
items.value: 1 877 952 7277 toll free, or report online at rapp.bc.ca
items.source: BC synopsis page 2 (read directly); BC RAPP page

items.label: Duck season near Kamloops
items.value: District No. 3 (Kamloops area, MUs 3-12 to 3-20, 3-26 to 3-44): ducks 8 Sept to 23 Dec.
items.source: Migratory Birds Regulations, 2022, Schedule 3 Part 10 Table 1 item 3

items.label: Duck daily bag (BC)
items.value: 8 ducks a day (possession 24). Inside the 8: pintail 4, canvasback 4, goldeneye 2, harlequin 2.
items.source: Migratory Birds Regulations, 2022; BC Synopsis page 12

items.label: Shotgun for ducks
items.value: 10 gauge or smaller, max 3 shells (chamber + magazine) with a plug that needs disassembly to remove. Non toxic shot only.
items.source: Migratory Birds Regulations, 2022, s.37 and s.38

items.label: Ducks from a boat
items.value: Ducks and geese: no hunting from a moving boat that has a motor or sail. A boat still gliding from its motor counts as moving. Beached, anchored or tied off is OK. You may use a motorboat to pick up a bird already down, but in BC you may not shoot while the motor pushes the boat.
items.note: Since 1 October 2026 BC repealed its power boat definition and now uses the federal moving boat wording (B.C. Reg. 66/2026). The synopsis edition dated 2 October 2026 carries the new wording: page 11 items 23 and 24, and the page 12 retrieval lines.
items.source: Migratory Birds Regulations, 2022, s.41; Hunting Regulation s.17(1)(n) as amended by B.C. Reg. 66/2026; Wildlife Act s.27(1) and Designation and Exemption Regulation s.5.1

items.label: Chukar (Regions 3 and 8)
items.value: Regions 3 and 8: 1 Oct to 30 Nov. Daily 5, possession 15.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Region 3 white tailed deer (MU 3-27, 3-28)
items.value: Bucks 10 Sept to 10 Dec. Antlerless (does) 10 to 31 Oct, no draw. Bow only, either sex 11 to 20 Dec.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Region 3 black bear
items.value: 1 Sept to 30 Nov and 1 Apr to 30 June. Bag 2. Never a bear under 2 years or any bear with it.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Moose near Heffley Creek (MU 3-27, 3-28)
items.value: Spike fork bulls only, 1 to 15 Nov. Bag 1. Mandatory Hunter Report by 31 March.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Elk in Region 3
items.value: No general open season. LEH draw only.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)

items.label: Region 3 grouse (dusky, ruffed, spruce)
items.value: 10 Sept to 30 Nov. 5 of each a day, 10 total (possession 3 times). .22 rimfire is legal for grouse.
items.source: BC Synopsis 2026 to 2028 (official PDF, read directly)
